scope: Secondary diagnostic after observing constant middle-band predictions; not fresh certification or a promotion gate.
purpose: Separate score-type cues and answer-position preferences from failure to apply numeric rules before investing in further training.
model_policy: Same frozen registered weight hashes and original predictor settings. No training, calibration, instruction editing or model selection.
questions: Only the ordinal band question, one question per group in every condition. Recompute the unmodified baseline in this same single-question protocol; do not attribute a difference from the earlier packed encoder run to type or order.
invariants: Preserve each state, instruction, option key/description pair, and semantic gold label. Only declared question type and option presentation order vary; remap gold and probabilities to canonical semantic keys.
execution: Fixed round-robin conditions per state; deterministic state order from the registered source. Record model/source hashes, every normalized probability vector and all failures.
primary: Accuracy and semantic prediction distribution per condition; paired within-state differences from score/original-order condition.
secondary: Semantic prediction invariance across cyclic option orders within each question type.
uncertainty: Exploratory paired state bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 13; no multiplicity-adjusted claim.
limits: Repeated synthetic rules in four English settings. This diagnostic cannot be a training or checkpoint-selection set. Any implementation change still needs separate representative validation and fresh confirmation.
compute: Laptop only through C:/temp/run_heavy.py, at most 12 minutes including load and thermal pauses, unchanged thermal governor, no valid latency claim. No new RunPod resources or spending. Preserve and stop on a thermal failure.
